# glad

The OpenGL function loader, generated by [glad](https://github.com/Dav1dde/glad) 0.1.33:

```
--profile="core" --api="gl=3.3" --generator="c" --spec="gl" --extensions=""
```

(https://glad.dav1d.de/#profile=core&language=c&specification=gl&loader=on&api=gl%3D3.3)

The generated `glad.h` / `glad.c` are public domain (or CC0 / WTFPL, as the glad project
states for its output); they are derived from the Khronos OpenGL registry (Apache 2.0).
`include/KHR/khrplatform.h` is Khronos's, under the MIT-style licence in its header.
